title: DUT-4 Junction Temperature Bench Measurement
text: Board BRD-12 carrying DUT-4 was run at 18 W dissipation in a 25 degC ambient with 1.2 m/s forced airflow. Junction temperature reached 108 degC against a 125 degC rating, leaving a 17 degC margin. Thermocouple TC-3 on the heatsink base read 71 degC.
